title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: AU. whereas in recent years, the EU has doubled down on its criticism and actions against countries that attach great importance to the role of the family and traditional values; whereas this trend of trying to impose ideological LGBTIQ+ policies violates both the UN Charter’s principle of non-interference, and relevant paragraphs of the UN International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights, which the Union’s foreign policy should respect;
